name: HPatches
ability_definition: The ability to quickly and accurately compare similarities and differences among sets of letters, numbers, objects, pictures, or patterns. The things to be compared may be presented at the same time or one after the other. This ability also includes comparing a presented object with a remembered object.

task_realism.reasoning: Patch verification is a genuine same/different judgment on visual patterns, and retrieval against distractors loosely resembles searching for a matching item. Workplace perceptual-speed tasks look different, though. They include checking figures against source documents, proofreading codes, spotting defects on parts, and comparing forms. HPatches instead tests invariant correspondence of local photo patches under viewpoint and illumination change. That is a low-level vision primitive, not a clerical or inspection task.

evaluation_conditions.reasoning: The ability is defined by quickly and accurately comparing, yet scoring is offline mAP with no speed, latency or throughput measure. The inputs are curated, pre-cropped and normalized grayscale patches with ground-truth homographies. There are no time pressure, workflow context, mixed stimulus types or error costs like those in real checking work. Training on Liberty and testing on HPatches splits is a controlled research protocol, not real input variety.

construct_coverage.reasoning: It covers only the accuracy side, and only for pictures and patterns. Letters, numbers and symbol strings are absent, and the speed component is entirely unmeasured. Sequential presentation and comparison with a remembered object are not directly tested. Retrieval is at best a weak analog of those. Only a narrow slice of the construct is touched.

format_match.reasoning: The inputs are crops from real photographs, which gives slightly more realism than synthetic grids. However, 65x65 grayscale patches are not work artifacts, and the output is descriptor distances ranked for mAP rather than a same/different flag or a marked discrepancy on a document or object. The format serves descriptor engineering, not workplace comparison outputs.

transferability_reasoning: HPatches does test same/different visual pattern comparison, so it has a real but thin link to perceptual speed's accuracy side. It ignores speed entirely and covers no letters or numbers. It also uses artificial patch stimuli and mAP scoring far removed from clerical checking or visual inspection. Strong HPatches results show robust local visual correspondence, not workplace perceptual-speed capability.

2020.metric: mean average precision (mAP, %) on HPatches patch verification
2020.human_reference: General adult workforce doing visual same/different comparison tasks (perceptual-speed style work such as inspection or clerical/visual matching)
